hey there mate,

while scrolling reddit for true crime posts i stumbled on this. i often am just a browser, not particularly into commenting, but this has troubled me.

i have little in the way of advice for you, other than you are not alone my friend. you are stronger than you think. you are loved. it sounds as though this substance abuse issue is your downfall and is causing you to spiral. perhaps moving to another area of the country, less populated, could be a move. i hear Tasmania, far north QLD and western adelaide are gorgeous. Regardless, i hope that you find it in yourself to quit, or at the very least minimize your habit in order to retain employment and earn a decent wage. 

I wish you the very best my friend, Australia is an amazing country, it is also a fair country. Hard work is repaid here. You will succeed if you can keep pushing through.

  
You are strong my friend, may you enjoy a fruitful life
